activity.notes: The Supreme Council created the presidency of the Kazakh SSR and elected Nazarbayev on 24 April 1990. This Activity ends on 10 December 1991, when the Kazakh SSR was renamed the Republic of Kazakhstan; his presidency continued without interruption under the new state name.

sources.title: Political activity — Library of the First President of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.citation_text: The First President's Library records Nazarbayev as President of the Kazakh SSR from April 1990 and President of the Republic of Kazakhstan from December 1991.
